subject: Role delegation audit & SCIM/SAML evidence request
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carealliance.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: security@carealliance.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Customer request: role delegation + SCIM/SAML artifacts

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. As part of our SIG intake we need a few pieces of evidence to close the IAM section: a SCIM delta export showing role assignments for the last 6 months, representative SAML assertion samples (with PII redacted), and a role ownership matrix that maps business roles to service principals and delegated admins.

Can you confirm you can provide:
- SCIM delta CSV (UTC timestamps) covering 2026-03-01 -> 2026-09-01
- 3 SAML assertion samples (login, provisioning, and an expired token example)
- Role ownership spreadsheet with current stewards and last modified date

We're aiming to submit the SIG by 10/4. If you need an NDA addendum or a secure transfer path (SFTP), flag it here and I'll loop security.

Best,
Samir
Security Lead, Care Alliance
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carealliance.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer request: role delegation + SCIM/SAML artifacts

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide all three items; plan below:

1) SCIM delta export: Karthik will generate a CSV with the delta feed and include actor/operation columns, plus a short README on how to interpret the timestamps. We can deliver via secure Drive link or SFTP.

2) SAML assertion samples: we'll redact any user-identifying fields and include a note about assertion audience and recipient.

3) Role ownership matrix: Marissa will stitch the per-tenant owner fields into a single spreadsheet and include 'last_owner_change' timestamps.

Deliverable ETA: 2026-09-27 EOD (PST). Please confirm preferred transfer method.

Jordan
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carealliance.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer request: role delegation + SCIM/SAML artifacts

Samir —

Uploading the artifacts now to a secured folder. Notes:
- Attached: role-ownership-mapping.xlsx (tabs: tenant-summary, steward-contact, change-log)
- Attached: scim-delta-202608.csv (we included operation, actor_id, target_id, and iso8601 timestamps). We filtered system heartbeats to keep size small.
- Attached: saml-assertion-samples.txt (PII redacted, each sample prefaced with the AuthnContext and audience).

Transfer method: secure Google Drive folder with restricted access (shared by link + specific accounts). If you require SFTP, let us know and we can push the pack there as well.

One ask: for the role-ownership sheet we marked a handful of 'steward' entries as "unverified" where last_owner_change is > 18 months; if you want us to run a re-verify to close those gaps, we can schedule a short sweep (est. 2-3 hours of engineering time) and include documented confirmation.

Marissa
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: role-ownership-mapping.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), scim-delta-202608.csv (text/csv), saml-assertion-samples.txt (text/plain)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@carealliance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Customer request: role delegation + SCIM/SAML artifacts

Marissa / Jordan —

Received the folder and quick review looks good. Two quick follow-ups:
1) For our SIG assessor we need explicit confirmation that the SCIM export includes deprovision events and service-account role assignments (not just user bindings). Can you add a one-paragraph attestation?
2) The assessor asked for one SAML assertion demonstrating a federated login where the assertion includes the 'groups' claim. Do you have a sample that includes groups? If not, please say so.

If you can drop the attestation into the Drive folder and reply, we'll be able to attach to the SIG pack and close the IAM section. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Samir
Security Lead, Care Alliance
